label: Supabase Commerce
description: Manage a Supabase-backed commerce catalogue with products, variants, offers, vendors, attributes and media.

instructions: Apply connectors/supabase/schema.sql to the target Supabase database.
Deploy the cms-commerce Edge Function and set its production secrets.
Enter the Functions base URL without a trailing slash and the private CMS commerce API key.
checks: The CMS only stores the source configuration and private API key reference.
Read endpoints use only the private CMS API key.
Write endpoints also forward x-cms-user-id for audit context.
The Edge Function does not infer roles or permissions from x-cms-user-id.
resources: Private commerce schema and Edge Function
review: Keep commerce tables private to anon and authenticated roles.
Do not expose the CMS commerce API key, Supabase service-role key, or secret keys to browser code.
Use Stripe Connect or payment-specific functions separately from this catalogue integration.
ui.syncNote: This integration creates a stateless CMS source. Supabase owns commerce catalogue rows.
